assertions.assertion: The patient presents with a history of recurrent palpitations consistent with supraventricular tachycardia
The patient is accompanied by episodes of dizziness
The patient had a recent event of syncope
The Holter monitor is ordered to correlate symptomatic episodes with potential arrhythmic activity and guide further management
CPT 93226 is the code for the 48-hour Holter monitor
Diagnosis code I47.1 supports the service
Diagnosis code R42 supports the service
Diagnosis code R55 supports the service
The service is medically necessary to evaluate the symptomatic arrhythmia underlying the syncope
